events.text: I say "It's really great, bro." while sitting on a wooden bench on an outdoor balcony terrace.
I unzip and search inside the main compartment of my backpack and pull out a black USB charging cable.
I hold the black cable in my right hand and reach back into the backpack with my left hand to retrieve a white power bank.
I hold the white power bank in my left hand and plug the USB-A connector of the black cable into its charging port.
I place the connected power bank into my backpack and hold the remaining end of the cable while looking out towards the cityscape.
I raise my hand to the side of my head to attach the charging cable to my smart glasses, partially blocking the camera view.
I adjust the smart glasses on my face with my hand partially obscuring the camera view while sitting on a balcony bench.
I lower my hand and look out briefly at the balcony view, then look down toward my lap.
I say 'Let's just both record the' while reaching into my pocket for my phone.
I hold my phone up in front of me, viewing the lock screen.
I unlock the phone and look at the iOS home screen.
I switch to the ChatGPT app showing an in-progress thinking query.
I swipe up to return to the iOS home screen and tap on the Aria app icon.
I open the Aria Dashboard app to check the smart glasses status and active recording progress.
I hold my phone and look at the smart glasses companion app settings page.
I swipe up on the screen with my right thumb to scroll down the settings page.
I view the lower section of the device settings menu on my phone.
